news.title: Necas and Roy score quick goals as the Avalanche rout the Blues 6-1
news.ruTitle: Necas and Roy score quick goals as the Avalanche rout the Blues 6-1
news.description: — Nicolas Roy and Martin Necas scored 23 seconds apart in a four-goal second period, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the St. Louis Blues 6-1 on Saturday night.

news.title: Kaprizov scores twice as the Wild beat the Bruins 4-1
news.ruTitle: Kaprizov scores twice as the Wild beat the Bruins 4-1
news.description: — Kirill Kaprizov scored twice, Jesper Wallstedt made 26 saves, and the Minnesota Wild beat the Boston Bruins 4-1 on Saturday night.

news.title: Saros makes 29 saves as Predators beat Stars 2-1
news.ruTitle: Saros makes 29 saves as Predators beat Stars 2-1
news.description: — Steven Stamkos and Nils Hoglander scored power-play goals in the first period, Juuse Saros made 29 saves and the Nashville Predators beat the Dallas Stars 2-1 on Saturday night.

news.title: Sorokin has 30th career shutout as Islanders blank Devils 6-0
news.ruTitle: Sorokin has 30th career shutout as Islanders blank Devils 6-0
news.description: — Ilya Sorokin made 36 saves for his 30th career shutout in a 6-0 win over the New Jersey Devils on Saturday.

news.title: Novak scores 2 goals, including OT winner, to help the Penguins beat the Canadiens 6-5
news.ruTitle: Novak scores 2 goals, including OT winner, to help the Penguins beat the Canadiens 6-5
news.description: — Tommy Novak scored his second goal of the game in overtime to give the Pittsburgh Penguins a 6-5 victory over the Montreal Canadiens on Saturday night.

news.title: McDavid has a goal and an assist as the Oilers beat the Kraken 3-1
news.ruTitle: McDavid has a goal and an assist as the Oilers beat the Kraken 3-1
news.description: — Connor McDavid had a goal and an assist to give him nine points through three games as the Edmonton Oilers beat the Seattle Kraken 3-1 on Saturday night.

news.title: Hurricanes beat the Flyers 3-2 in OT for their first win as Aho scores 2
news.ruTitle: Hurricanes beat the Flyers 3-2 in OT for their first win as Aho scores 2
news.description: — Sebastian Aho scored a pair of goals and assisted on Shayne Gostisbehere's overtime winner as the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Saturday night.

news.title: Senators open season with a 3-2 victory over the Maple Leafs
news.ruTitle: Senators open season with a 3-2 victory over the Maple Leafs
news.description: — Stephen Halliday broke a tie at 9:46 of the third period, Linus Ullmark made 27 saves and the Ottawa Senators opened the season with a 3-2 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday night.

news.title: Lightning beat the Capitals 3-1 in home opener
news.ruTitle: Lightning beat the Capitals 3-1 in home opener
news.description: — Andrei Vasilevskiy made 19 saves, Charle-Edouard D'Astous and Conor Geekie scored in the first period and the Tampa Bay Lightning won their home opener with a 3-1 victory over the Washington Capitals on Saturday night.

news.title: Nick Schmaltz scores twice, reaches 500 points as Mammoth beat Blue Jackets 4-1
news.ruTitle: Nick Schmaltz scores twice, reaches 500 points as Mammoth beat Blue Jackets 4-1
news.description: — Nick Schmaltz had two goals and the Utah Mammoth scored three times on the power play to beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 4-1 on Saturday night for its second straight victory to open the season.

news.title: Jiri Kulich scores go-ahead goal, Sabres rally to beat the Blackhawks 4-3
news.ruTitle: Jiri Kulich scores go-ahead goal, Sabres rally to beat the Blackhawks 4-3
news.description: — Jiri Kulich scored with 6:40 left and the Sabres overcame a two-goal deficit to beat the Chicago Blackhawks 4-3 in Buffalo’s home-opener on Saturday night.
